test_runs.output:
=== The verdict: what a BMC reading establishes about the host ===
  ok   an unreachable BMC yields host_state UNKNOWN, never 'down'
  ok   the unreachable verdict names the conclusion NOT to draw
  ok   PowerState Off is reported as a FACT about the host
  ok   PowerState On carries the caveat that the OS may be hung
  ok   an unrecognised PowerState is UNREPORTED, not guessed
  ok   a hardware fault is reported as independent of OS state
  ok   deriving a host state from an unreachable BMC is refused
  ok   emitting a host claim without a verdict is refused
  ok   a host claim WITH a verdict is allowed

=== Read-only is enforced at the transport ===
  ok   the client implements no verb but GET
  ok   ComputerSystem.Reset is never invoked anywhere in the server
  ok   an unset endpoint refuses rather than guessing an address

=== Live against the DMTF mockup (needs httpx + container) ===
  ok   systems are read from a real Redfish service with a verdict attached
  ok   an unreachable endpoint yields UNKNOWN, not a host claim

=== Empty results must not read as good news ===
  ok   TLS verification being off is disclosed, not silent

=== Summary ===
  passed: 15
  failed: 0
  skipped: 0
  all redfish-mcp contract tests passed
